title: Micron's Monster Rally Faces New Threat As Traders Pile Into Bearish Bets

delta_candidates.proposition: 据报道，周五截至午间，VanEck Semiconductor ETF有超过180,000份看跌期权成交、约50,000份看涨期权成交；相关看跌期权溢价约4,600万美元，看涨期权溢价约2,600万美元。
SpotGamma数据显示，周五约2.7亿美元期权溢价与可能的Micron看跌期权买入相关，包括2028年6月到期的深度价内合约；一组行权价为2,250至2,500美元的看跌期权交易被报道为可能构成约1,450万美元的看跌价差，但其净方向无法仅凭买卖报价确定。

expert_trade.prior_expectation: 事件前基线显示AI/服务器内存需求及FY26 Q4经营展望强劲、HBM商业化推进，但FY27盈利持续性与内存周期风险仍未完全确定；没有可靠的期权净仓位共识基线。
expert_trade.reason: 期权数据虽新且金额显著，但报道明确存在价差交易及买卖价差分类不确定性，所列合约也可能是对冲，不能据此确认方向性净空头或持续卖压。没有基本面恶化或可靠的ticker级传导，故不足以形成可辩护的直接LONG或SHORT交易。

snapshot.body: Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ) is drawing mixed signals from investors as bearish options activity builds across semiconductor stocks while analysts continue to point to strong AI-driven memory demand . The stock traded lower by 2% on Monday. However, it still gained over 260% in 2026 driven by AI-driven of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM, and enterprise storage crisis. Bearish Options Activity Builds Options traders increased downside bets across the semiconductor sector on Friday. More than 180,000 puts traded in the VanEck Semiconductor ETF by midday, compared with about 50,000 calls. Roughly $46 million in premium was tied to puts versus $26 million in calls, according to ThinkOrSwim and SpotGamma data, CNBC reported on Friday. Micron also saw significant bearish activity. SpotGamma data showed roughly $270 million in premium tied to likely put buying, including deep in-the-money contracts expiring in June 2028. A group of trades involving puts with strike prices between $2,250 and $2,500 appeared to form part of a bearish spread. Taken at face value, the position represented about $14.5 million and behaved similarly to a synthetic short. However, Volland founder Jason DeLorenzo cautioned against drawing firm conclusions from bid-ask activity. “Spreads have difficulty being categorized by midpoint analysis as well, because dealers are willing to take a haircut on one leg while getting a better premium with the other,” DeLorenzo said. See More: Top Quality Stocks AI Changes Memory’s Role D.A. Davidson Managing Director Gil Luria remains bullish on Micron, arguing that AI has fundamentally changed the role of memory . Luria recently raised his 12-month price forecast to $3,000 from $2,100, citing strong AI and memory demand. He told CNBC that investors still view Micron through the lens of its historically cyclical memory business. Three years ago, customers primarily used memory for storage. Luria said AI now makes memory central to model performance and speed. “The more memory you put to a model, the better it works. The more memory, the faster the model works. The more memory, the bigger the context window,” Luria said. Longer Deals Could Reduce Cyclicality Luria expects more than half of Micron’s products to be sold through five-year agreements as Microsoft Corp. (NASDAQ: MSFT ) , Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) and Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) increasingly design specific memory products into their data centers. “The product is no longer a commodity, it’s no longer sold like a commodity,” Luria said. He believes longer contracts could make Micron’s business more predictable than during previous memory cycles. Buybacks Add Another Catalyst Luria said Micron can resume share repurchases on Dec. 9, when restrictions on its buyback expire. He noted that management has said it plans to use 100% of excess cash flow for opportunistic share repurchases. MU Price Action: Micron Technology shares were down 1.78% at $1010.69 during premarket trading on Monday, according to Benzinga Pro data . Photo via Shutterstock Read Also: Micron Analyst Dismisses Supply Glut Fears As AI Memory Crunch Deepens
